title: A CMOS Transconductance Amplifier Architecture With Wide Tuning Range for Very Low Frequency Applications
figure_number: Fig. 4. Common-mode feedback circuit. (a) Block diagram. (b) Circuit using floating gates.
function_summary: CMOS Transconductance Amplifier Architecture: A pseudodifferential CMOS operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) with wide tuning range and large input voltage swing has been designed for very small ’s (of the order of a few nanoamperes per volt).
